Package org.cha0scollective.wwpg.api.neoforge

Interface MeasurementService

public interface MeasurementService
WWPG runtime discovery service used by ElectricalMeasurements. The WWPG runtime supplies the single implementation through META-INF/services. Add-ons consume the facade; registering a second service is a configuration error.
